user_story: As a staff member, I want confirming an already-cancelled booking to return an error so that invalid state transitions are blocked.

positive.title: Confirm a booking that is active and not cancelled
steps: Step 1: Log in as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the booking management system.
Step 3: Search for an active booking that has not been cancelled.
positive.expected_result: The booking is confirmed successfully, and no errors are returned.

negative.title: Attempt to confirm an already-cancelled booking
steps: Step 1: Log in as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the booking management system.
Step 3: Search for a booking that has already been cancelled.
Step 5: Attempt to confirm the booking.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that an already-cancelled booking cannot be confirmed.

edge.title: Attempt to confirm a booking immediately after it is cancelled
steps: Step 1: Log in as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the booking management system.
Step 3: Search for an active booking.
Step 4: Select the booking and cancel it.
Step 5: Immediately attempt to confirm the booking.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that an already-cancelled booking cannot be confirmed, even immediately after cancellation.
